values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day campsite reservations until 3 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are permitted on campsites. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away. Loops A, B and C allow no pets.

note:
Despite the name, the campground is set back from Lake Ontario in wooded loops.  --AWH
Many ash trees in the campground were cut because of emerald ash borer, leaving a more open canopy (ReserveAmerica alert, read 2026-10-21). --Claude
summary: Confirmed 2027 season May 21-Oct 10, reservable on ReserveAmerica (booking was only inherited; now verified). Added 9-month window, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max, 50 A (every site electric: 157 x 30 A, 111 x 50 A), 274 sites to 40 ft (back-in), showers, dump, laundry, water fill. No site is tagged 'Near Water', consistent with AWH's note. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. AWH note kept; dated emerald-ash-borer canopy caveat added.
